school_name: University of North Carolina School of the Arts
title: Your First Weekend at University of North Carolina School of the Arts, Shared as Cards
description: A low-pressure first-weekend route through UNCSA’s named campus spaces, ending with a current performance-calendar check.

cards.title: Start with the Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · campus orientation point
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the Welcome Center, then orient yourself to South Main Street and the nearby campus entrances before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a named campus landmark and get your bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA’s official campus map lists the Welcome Center as a campus location.
cards.source_title: University of North Carolina School of the Arts Interactive Campus Maps
cards.access_notes: Use the official interactive map for routing; building access may vary.

cards.title: Find the student commons
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus gathering space
cards.notes: Walk to Hanes Student Commons and note its dining, mail, wellness and Student Affairs services so you know where to return during the week.
cards.short_summary: Identify the campus hub and its practical student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map lists Hanes Student Commons with Eisenberg Social Hall, Dining Hall, Pickle Jar, P.O.D. Market, Wellness Center, Mail Center and Student Affairs offices.
cards.access_notes: Campus services and building access can vary; check the relevant office before a special trip.

cards.title: Locate the Library and Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · study and research waypoint
cards.notes: Add the Library and Learning Commons to your mental map, then use the student-services page to reach the library’s current information and resources.
cards.short_summary: Make a future study-and-research stop easy to find.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA lists the Library and Learning Commons on its campus map and links students to Library services.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library directly for current access and service details.

cards.title: Pause at Daniels Plaza
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · central outdoor landmark
cards.notes: Use Daniels Plaza as a meet-up landmark for a campus walk, then continue toward the nearby performance and academic buildings shown on the official map.
cards.short_summary: Choose a named central landmark for an easy regroup point.
cards.evidence_claim: Daniels Plaza is identified as a named location on UNCSA’s official campus map.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is generally route-dependent; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Spot the ACE Exhibition Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · performance-venue orientation
cards.notes: Walk by the ACE Exhibition Complex and identify its Main, Gold and Babcock theatres on the map; check the performance calendar before planning an event visit.
cards.short_summary: Connect several named theatre spaces to one campus complex.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA’s campus map identifies the ACE Exhibition Complex and its Main Theatre, Gold Theatre and Babcock Theatre.
cards.access_notes: Performance access is event-specific; use the official calendar for availability and tickets.

cards.title: Recognize Performance Place
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · theatre cluster
cards.notes: Find Alex Ewing Performance Place and note the Freedman, Catawba and Patrons theatres listed there; save the calendar for future program details.
cards.short_summary: Learn one of UNCSA’s major on-campus performance locations.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA lists Alex Ewing Performance Place among its campus performance venues and identifies Freedman, Catawba and Patrons theatres there on the campus map.
cards.access_notes: Venue entry depends on the scheduled program and its admission terms.

cards.title: Find Watson Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · music-complex landmark
cards.notes: Locate Watson Hall in the School of Music Complex and check the official performance listings when you want to attend a recital or concert.
cards.short_summary: Add a principal music venue to your campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA identifies Watson Chamber Music Hall in the School of Music Complex and describes it as the principal venue for School of Music faculty and guest-artist concert series.
cards.access_notes: Programs and entry are event-specific; consult the official performance calendar.

cards.title: Note Hood Recital Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · intimate recital venue
cards.notes: Mark Hood Recital Hall in the Gray Building for a future student recital, and confirm the individual event’s details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Recognize a small named venue used for recitals.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA identifies Hood Recital Hall in the Gray Building and describes it as the smallest on-campus performance venue, with 39 seats.
cards.access_notes: Entry and timing depend on the scheduled recital or event.

cards.title: Pass the de Mille Theatre
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · dance and opera venue
cards.notes: Locate the Agnes de Mille Theatre beside the Workplace complex, then watch the official calendar for a suitable dance concert or opera workshop program.
cards.short_summary: Learn a named campus theatre tied to dance and opera activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA states that the Agnes de Mille Theatre is used primarily for School of Dance concerts and A. J. Fletcher Opera Institute workshops and productions.
cards.access_notes: Attendance requires a scheduled program; review event-specific admission details.

cards.title: Choose a Sunday performance
cards.subtitle: Sunday planning · performances, recitals or screenings
cards.notes: Open the official performance calendar and choose an upcoming under-21-safe event that fits your schedule; confirm the venue, ticket status and start time on its listing.
cards.short_summary: Turn campus orientation into a specific arts plan.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCSA’s performance calendar lists upcoming events, and the university states that film screenings and student recitals are among events offered free of charge, while selected events have individual prices.
cards.access_notes: Check the individual listing for the current date, venue, admission and any ticket requirement.
